title: Gradient Norm Clipping
hint: Total norm = sqrt(sum(p.grad.norm()^2)). If total > max_norm, scale all grads by max_norm/total. Return original total norm.

description.text: Implement gradient norm clipping. Compute the total L2 norm of all parameter gradients; if it exceeds max_norm, scale every grad in-place so the total norm equals max_norm. Return the original (pre-clip) total norm as a float.

examples.input: Two parameters with grads of norm 3 and 4; max_norm = 5
examples.output: Pre-clip total norm = 5; after clip, scaled down so combined norm = 5; return value 5.
examples.explanation: If total <= max_norm, grads are unchanged; return value is still the computed total.

constraints: Skip parameters with grad is None.
